title: phyllanthus clamboides
intro: Phyllanthus clamboides, commonly known as Bhumyamalaki, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a herb traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to support liver health and digestion. The health benefits of Phyllanthus clamboides include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and promote liver function. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus clamboides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-hepatotoxic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
